rationale_overall: Single-slot watchlist (cap=1) stays NVDA. Q4 2024 evidence shows continuation, not a crest: Nvidia's Q3 FY25 call reported Blackwell and Hopper shipping into Q4 with demand outstripping supply, and Blackwell volume was on track to scale in December. I weighed swapping into a nuclear name on the Oct hyperscaler SMR wave (Alphabet-Kairos Oct 14, Amazon-X-energy Oct 16, AWS-Talen PPA) and the post-election nuclear rally, but every nuclear name targets commissioning in the early 2030s — a multi-year runway versus NVDA's monetizing-today Blackwell ramp. A pre-revenue SMR swap in a one-ticker slot is a downgrade in exposure quality. Hold NVDA.
